    t.id,
    f.code AS field_code,
    t.code AS theme_code,
    t.name,
    LENGTH(t.embedding) AS embedding_text_length
FROM theme t
JOIN field f ON f.id = t.field_id
ORDER BY t.id;

COMMIT;
